full_source_sigma: Robust sigma_of uses all source pixels, including validation. The frequency-independent noise subtraction does not normally change proposal ranking, but the acceptance-cost sigma and phase/linear uncertainty are dependent on held-out data. This is not independent validation or confidence.
validation_reuse: Slot2 reuses the same held-out pixels after slot1 binary acceptance. This adaptive reuse is not a new independent test; false-feature/shared-noise adversaries are retained.
FFT_cost: At most two frozen streaming steps per validframe, but sigma_of separately computes a source rFFT. Total implemented rFFT calls are background_steps+residual_steps+source_sigma_calls; source_sigma_calls equals background_steps. The prior shorthand twoFFT was twofrozensteps, not all FFTs. No cost reduction/tuning before scores.
frequency_uncertainty: Linear Gamma/circular envelope is conditional on fitted frequency. Full frequency-selection/nonlinear nuisance error is omitted. Exact Nyquist frequency Fisher can be singular even though retained physical rank1 coefficient covariance is finite and phase is set0. Neither rank1 phase0 nor conditional covariance means frequency uncertainty0.
residual_covariance: Raw-fit projection induces correlated residual coefficients even under raw IID. Carrier is source-dependent and affects current DC. Original frozen residualpilot is retained as a prototype control mechanism, not a proof its IID noise model is valid.
warmup_activation: First8 exactraw outputs preserve raw byte detail and noise. Model or no-atom fallback starts afterwarmup; fullsequence transitions may fail even with mature gains. At accepted-model activation, coefficient and residual history start anew on currentframe, not on warmup data.
budget_failure_reporting: BudgetFailure reason is retained in perframe diagnostics and exactraw/epochcut is selfchecked. Proposal counters are reported on completed selection; a throwing selection has no completed counter result, so reason is authoritative and missing counter totals are not silently inferred.
scope: No native input/output, oldT(P), game, production, confidence or quality acceptance. Root oracle math package is interpretation only and not a source estimator input.
